claim.claim-text: 1. A preblend composition comprising carbon nanostructures and a particulate solid prepared by wet-mixing in a liquid medium.
2. The preblend composition of claim 1 wherein the preblend comprises a nanotube network with carbon black particles dispersed therein.
3. The preblend composition of claim 1 wherein the preblend comprises carbon black particles coated with nanotubes.
4. The preblend composition of claim 1 wherein the preblend comprises graphitic carbon particles coated with carbon nanostructures.
5. The preblend composition of claim 1 wherein the preblend comprises solid core particles coated with a shell of carbon nanostructures forming a core-shell material.
6. The preblend composition of claim 5 wherein:
7. The preblend composition of claim 1 comprising carbon nanostructures and a particulate solid prepared by wet-mixing in a liquid medium followed by the drying of the solid compositions.
8. The preblend composition of claim 7 wherein the preblend comprises:
9. The preblend composition of claim 7 wherein the preblend comprises solid core particles coated with a shell of carbon nanostructures forming a core-shell material.
10. The core-shell material of claim 9 wherein:

(i) the core particles are regular or irregular in shape and have a size in the range of 20 nm to 20 µm in terms of average longest dimension; or (ii) the shell coating on the core particles cover a surface area in the range of 50-100% of the total surface area of the core particles.
11. The composition of claim 9 wherein:

(i) the core particles are graphitic, glassy or structureless carbon; or (ii) the carbon nanostructures consist of one or more from the group consisting of fullerenes, single-walled carbon nanotubes, multi-walled carbon nanotubes, and their chemical derivatives.

12. The preblend composition of claim 1 comprising carbon nanostructures and a particulate solid; prepared by wet-mixing said carbon nanostructures and said particulate solid in a liquid medium followed by drying; wherein the preblend comprises solid core particles coated with a shell of carbon nanostructures forming a core-shell material; and wherein the core particles comprise particles selected from the group consisting of carbon black, graphitic carbon and glassy carbon.

13. The preblend composition of claim 12 wherein the carbon nanostructures consist of one or more from the group consisting of fullerenes, single-walled carbon nanotubes, multi-walled carbon nanotubes, and their chemical derivatives.
14. The preblend composition of claim 12 or 13 wherein the shell coating on the core particles cover a surface area in the range of 50-100% of the total surface area of the core particles.
15. A method comprising:

(i) drying said blend to form a preblend and using the preblend as part of a battery electrode or as part of an electrolyte medium in a super capacitor; or (ii) using the preblend in an electrolyte medium, paint, coating, or slurry.
